marked v16.4.2
https://github.com/markedjs/marked

Vendor copy of the marked UMD build (lib/marked.umd.js), renamed to
marked.min.js.

Source of the copy: frontend/node_modules/.pnpm/marked@16.4.2/node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js
(the version pinned by frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml for @humanspeak/svelte-markdown).

Keep this file at the SAME major version as the marked engine used by the
public feed (@humanspeak/svelte-markdown). Updating is a deliberate manual
sync: replace this file from the new frontend/node_modules copy and bump
the version in this header.
